# Preserve pitch on playback<AvailableFrom v="4.0.538" />

Preserve audio pitch when changing the Studio playback speed. Defaults to `true`. Applies to `Audio` and `Video` from `@remotion/media`, independently of their clip-level `preservePitch` props. Does not affect rendered output or native media components, including native fallbacks. Set `--preserve-pitch-on-playback=false` to disable.

## CLI flag

```text
--preserve-pitch-on-playback
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setPreservePitchOnPlayback(false);
```
